caption: Colosseum, Rome
composition: Ancient amphitheatre exterior · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands on the curved street facing the Colosseum's great oval, which fills the frame center with its three tiers of travertine arches. A tall cypress and pale apartment blocks line the left edge while ochre facades and plane trees close the right, and the empty asphalt road sweeps across the foreground. The 14:30 September sun is high and bright, throwing crisp shadows across the stonework under a clear blue sky.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Colosseum in Rome under afternoon light
